description: Gares et stations du réseau ferré schématique d'Île-de-France (petit format) is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche schématique décrivant, par ligne, les gares de Train, de RER et de Val (mais pas les stations de métro, de tramways, de funiculaire) ouvertes aux voyageurs en Île-de-France. La représentation schématique des objets est adaptée à une utilisation "petit format" pour une petite échelle. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Arrêts. Its keywords are Réseau ferré, Schématique. The portal shows 2024-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
